meta.purpose: Single MTG taxonomy. aliases + oracle_hints are for query expansion; keywords + card_text_regex + examples are for labeling and eval. Not on the live search path yet.
meta.regex: card_text_regex values are Python patterns, matched case-insensitively against printed oracle text (with {T} notation, not the MiniLM-preprocessed form).

taxonomy.name: Card Advantage
taxonomy.description: Card advantage: gaining access to more cards than your opponent. Includes direct draw, tutoring, impulse draw (exile-based), cheating cards into play, card filtering (loot, rummage, surveil, scry), and recursion from the graveyard.

children.name: Draw
children.description: Direct card draw — adding cards from library to hand.

children.name: Cantrip
children.description: A cheap spell that replaces itself by drawing a card. Cycling (discard to draw) is a related mechanic.

children.name: Symmetric Draw
children.description: Each player discards their hand and draws a new one. Named after Wheel of Fortune.

children.name: Tutor
children.description: Search your library for a specific card. Named after Demonic Tutor. Subtypes based on where the card goes.

children.name: Tutor to Hand
children.description: Search library, put card into hand.

children.name: Tutor to Top
children.description: Search library, put card on top.

children.name: Tutor to Battlefield
children.description: Search library, put directly onto the battlefield.

children.name: Entomb
children.description: Search library, put into graveyard (for recursion).

children.name: Impulse Draw
children.description: Exile cards from the top of your library and cast them temporarily. Common in red.
card_text_regex: exile the top (\d+) cards (?:of your library)?
until (?:end of turn|your next turn),? you may play (?:cards exiled|them)

children.name: Cheat into Play
children.description: Put permanents onto the battlefield or cast spells without paying their mana cost. Cascade, Discover, Plot, Suspend, and Storm are the named methods.

children.name: Cascade
children.description: When you cast this, exile cards until you hit a cheaper spell and cast that without paying.
oracle_hints: exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less

children.name: Discover
children.description: Exile cards from the top until you hit mana value N or less; cast it without paying or put it into hand.
oracle_hints: exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value

children.name: Plot
children.description: Exile a card plotted and cast it on a later turn without paying its mana cost.

children.name: Suspend
children.description: Exile with time counters; when the last is removed, cast it without paying its mana cost.
oracle_hints: if you cast it using suspend

children.name: Storm
children.description: Copy the spell for each other spell cast this turn.

children.name: Card Filtering
children.description: Improving card quality without strict card advantage — loot, rummage, scry, surveil.

children.name: Loot
children.description: Draw a card, then discard a card.

children.name: Rummage
children.description: Discard a card, then draw a card.

children.name: Scry
children.description: Look at the top N cards of your library, put any on bottom in any order.

children.name: Surveil
children.description: Look at the top N cards, put any into your graveyard and the rest back on top.

children.name: Recursion
children.description: Return cards from the graveyard to hand, battlefield, or top of library.

children.name: Reanimation
children.description: Return a creature from graveyard to battlefield.
oracle_hints: from your graveyard to the battlefield

children.name: Regrowth
children.description: Return a card from graveyard to hand.
oracle_hints: from your graveyard to your hand

taxonomy.name: Disruption / Interaction
taxonomy.description: Answering your opponent's threats. Includes targeted removal, burn, mass removal (board wipes), counters, bounce, ability denial, discard, stax, and tax. Mill-as-hate and graveyard hate live under graveyard.*; aristocrats/self-mill are advantage.

children.name: Targeted Removal
children.description: Destroy, exile, or otherwise remove a single permanent.

children.name: Destroy
children.description: Destroy target creature or permanent.

children.name: Exile-Based Removal
children.description: Exile target creature or permanent.

children.name: Damage-Based Removal
children.description: Deal damage to a creature to kill it. The burn methodology (face or any-target) lives at interaction.burn.

children.name: Shrink
children.description: Give a creature -N/-N to weaken or kill it.

children.name: Edict
children.description: Force an opponent to sacrifice a creature (bypasses hexproof/indestructible).

children.name: Tuck
children.description: Put a permanent on the bottom of its owner's library.

children.name: Burn / Direct Damage
children.description: Deal damage as the method — to creatures (removal) or to players (the burn win condition). Distinct from destroy/exile removal.

children.name: Creature Burn
children.description: Damage aimed at creatures as removal.

children.name: Face Burn
children.description: Damage aimed at players as a win condition.

children.name: Mass Removal
children.description: Remove all or most creatures/permanents from the battlefield. Named after Wrath of God.

children.name: Counterspell
children.description: Counter a spell on the stack, preventing it from resolving.

children.name: Hard Counter
children.description: Unconditionally counter a spell.

children.name: Soft Counter
children.description: Counter unless the opponent pays additional mana.

children.name: Protection
children.description: Protect your permanents from opponent interaction — hexproof, ward, indestructible, protection from, phasing.

children.name: Bounce
children.description: Return a permanent to its owner's hand. Tempo, not permanent removal — the card can be replayed.

children.name: Ability Denial
children.description: Strip or shut off abilities without killing the permanent — Pacifism, Turn to Frog, Humility, 'loses all abilities'.

children.name: Hand Disruption
children.description: Force opponents to discard, or otherwise attack the hand.

children.name: Stax
children.description: Restrict what opponents can do — prevent untapping, prohibit casting or activating, lock pieces. Distinct from tax, which raises costs instead of forbidding the action.

children.name: Tax
children.description: Make opponents pay extra to cast, attack, or activate — Rhystic Study, Sphere of Resistance, Ghostly Prison. The action is still legal; it just costs more.

taxonomy.name: Theft
taxonomy.description: Take opponent's cards — permanent control, until-end-of-turn threaten effects, or casting from their zones.

children.name: Permanent Control
children.description: Gain control of a permanent with no end-of-turn clause.

children.name: Threaten
children.description: Gain control until end of turn, usually with haste, then give it back (often after sacrificing it).
oracle_hints: gain control of target creature until end of turn
gains haste until end of turn

children.name: Cast from Opponent
children.description: Play or cast cards from an opponent's hand, library, graveyard, or exile.

taxonomy.name: Control
taxonomy.description: The control archetype: answer threats, win the long game. Permission (counters), board control, tap-down, extra turns, and pillowfort. The bare word 'control' is not an alias — it collides with theft ('gain control of').

children.name: Permission
children.description: Hold up mana to counter spells. Same oracle family as interaction.counterspell; kept here so the control branch expands.

children.name: Tap-Down
children.description: Tap opposing permanents and often keep them from untapping.

children.name: Pillowfort
children.description: Make attacking you expensive or illegal. Ghostly Prison and Propaganda also live under interaction.tax.

children.name: Extra Turns
children.description: Take an additional turn after this one.

taxonomy.name: Buff / Enhance
taxonomy.description: Making your creatures stronger — through anthems, counters, temporary pump spells, keyword granting, or equipment/auras.

children.name: Anthem
children.description: Permanent effect that buffs all your creatures. 'Lord' refers to type-specific buffs (all Elves get +1/+1).

children.name: Counters
children.description: Permanent buffs via +1/+1 counters or keyword counters (flying counter, trample counter, etc.).

children.name: Pump
children.description: Temporary power/toughness boost, usually until end of turn. Combat tricks are pump spells cast during combat.

children.name: Keyword Granting
children.description: Give creatures keyword abilities — haste, flying, trample, lifelink, deathtouch, indestructible, double strike, etc.

children.name: Equipment & Auras
children.description: Persistent buffs through Equipment (re-attachable artifacts) or Auras (enchantments attached to creatures). Voltron is the strategy of loading one creature with many.

taxonomy.name: Mana Acceleration
taxonomy.description: Getting ahead on mana — through land tutors, mana creatures, mana rocks, Treasure tokens, cost reduction, doublers, and extra land drops.

children.name: Land Tutor
children.description: Search your library for a land and put it onto the battlefield (true ramp) or into your hand.
oracle_hints: search your library for a land
search your library for a basic land
put it onto the battlefield tapped

children.name: Mana Dork
children.description: A creature that taps to produce mana. Usually fragile but provides early acceleration.

children.name: Mana Rock
children.description: An artifact that taps to produce mana.
oracle_hints: add one mana of any color

children.name: Treasure Tokens
children.description: Create Treasure tokens — artifact tokens you sacrifice to add one mana of any color.

children.name: Cost Reduction
children.description: Make spells cheaper to cast — flat cost reduction, Affinity, Convoke (tap creatures), Delve (exile graveyard), Improvise (tap artifacts).

children.name: Mana Doubler
children.description: Effects that double or multiply mana production — 'whenever a land is tapped for mana, add one additional'.
card_text_regex: whenever you tap a land for mana

children.name: Extra Land Drops
children.description: Play additional lands per turn beyond the normal one.

children.name: Fast Mana
children.description: Burst mana that is not a land drop you keep — zero- and low-cost rocks, rituals, and similar accelerants.

children.name: Rituals
children.description: A spell that adds a burst of mana, often cheaper than the mana produced or paid by sacrificing.
oracle_hints: add one mana of any color
card_text_regex: add \d+ mana of any one color

taxonomy.name: Evasion
taxonomy.description: Abilities that make creatures hard or impossible to block — flying, menace, trample, shadow, fear, skulk, horsemanship, or full unblockability.

taxonomy.name: Graveyard Strategies
taxonomy.description: The graveyard as a zone. Synergy (self-mill, dredge, flashback, reanimate) is advantage. Milling the opponent or exiling yards is interaction. Bare 'mill' expands both self and opponent.

children.name: Cast from Graveyard
children.description: Cast or activate your own cards from the graveyard — Flashback, Unearth, Escape, Disturb, Embalm, Eternalize. This is advantage, not hate.
oracle_hints: cast this card from your graveyard

children.name: Mill
children.description: Put cards from a library into a graveyard. Self-mill fuels your yard (advantage). Milling the opponent is interaction or a win condition. Matching 'mill' expands both.

children.name: Self-Mill
children.description: Intentionally fill your own graveyard as a resource. Dredge, surveil-into-yard, 'put the top N of your library into your graveyard'.
oracle_hints: cards from the top of your library into your graveyard

children.name: Mill Opponent
children.description: Put cards from an opponent's library into their graveyard — interaction, or a mill-out win.
oracle_hints: cards from the top of their library

children.name: Graveyard Hate
children.description: Exile cards from graveyards to shut down yard synergy. Interaction, not a mill deck.
oracle_hints: exile target card from a graveyard
if a card would be put into a graveyard

taxonomy.name: Token Generation
taxonomy.description: Creating creature tokens, artifact tokens (Treasure, Food, Clue, Blood), or copy tokens.

children.name: Creature Tokens
children.description: Create creature tokens to build a board presence.

children.name: Artifact Tokens
children.description: Create artifact tokens with built-in abilities — Treasure (mana), Food (life), Clue (draw), Blood (loot), Powerstone (colorless mana), Map (explore).

children.name: Copy / Clone
children.description: Create token copies of existing creatures, spells, or permanents.
oracle_hints: create a token that's a copy

taxonomy.name: Sacrifice / Aristocrats
taxonomy.description: Sacrifice as advantage: you choose to sac your permanents for value (outlets + dies payoffs). Forcing an opponent to sacrifice is interaction — see interaction.targeted_removal.edict.
oracle_hints: whenever a creature you control dies

children.name: Sacrifice Outlet
children.description: Abilities that let you sacrifice permanents at will.

children.name: Dies Payoff
children.description: Effects that trigger when your creatures die — drain, draw, tokens. The other half of aristocrats.
oracle_hints: whenever a creature you control dies

children.name: Sac Fodder
children.description: Cheap or token creatures meant to be sacrificed, not to win combat.

taxonomy.name: Flicker / Blink
taxonomy.description: Exile a permanent then return it to the battlefield to retrigger enters-the-battlefield abilities.
oracle_hints: then return it to the battlefield
return that card to the battlefield

taxonomy.name: Combat Manipulation
taxonomy.description: Controlling how combat works — first strike, deathtouch, lifelink, vigilance, fog effects, goad, lure.

children.name: Fog
children.description: Prevent all combat damage for a turn.

children.name: Goad
children.description: Force opponents' creatures to attack someone else.

children.name: Lure
children.description: Force an opponent's creature to block yours.

taxonomy.name: Life Management
taxonomy.description: Gaining life, draining opponents, or paying life as a resource.

children.name: Life Gain
children.description: Gain life to stabilize or trigger payoffs.

children.name: Drain
children.description: Opponent loses life and you gain that much life.
